title: Dekopon tech almanac
description: A code-backed guide to Dekopon v0.2.0: sandboxes, custom tools, fine-grained permissions, auditing, and OpenTelemetry.

chapters.label: Atlas
chapters.title: See the whole system
chapters.description: Meet the agent runner, permission broker, sandboxed providers, audit trail, and telemetry in one clear map.

chapters.label: Wasm isolation
chapters.title: What can a provider reach?
chapters.description: See how pure local tools get no host access while networked tools receive one narrow, permissioned HTTP interface.

chapters.label: One-tool runtime
chapters.title: How one tool does more
chapters.description: Follow one agent plan through the safe scripting language, structured data, custom providers, and hard runtime limits.

chapters.label: Permissions
chapters.title: How every action gets checked
chapters.description: Follow one request through verified identity, an exact allow/deny rule, single-use approval, replay protection, and audit.

chapters.label: Audit & telemetry
chapters.title: How to see what happened
chapters.description: Learn when to use audit, traces, or logs. Then follow one run into OpenObserve and see its measured Raspberry Pi footprint.
